Prompt text shipped as data and the scripts that keep each copy equal to its source: standing deep-run instructions (evolvable_structure.md and the public docs/reference/evolvable-structure.md generated from the ESOI skill) and the vendored quest field guidance

Per-component evaluation harness: one function per component, impls swappable, same dataset; the combined QAR metric (qar_overall) reads their recorded rows; qar_overall/render_handoff.py renders the handoff page from them

Operator scripts, each the live operator of a solution: web-search bench (search-the-web), card quarantine (repair-a-card-store), restart-if-idle (run-queued-tasks); dataset_sheet exports labelled datasets (one or several files, with item and request metadata, need role and scope need) for human review and imports the corrections next to each source file (no solution of its own yet); qar_datasets_sheet writes the evaluation datasets, their inputs and the leading implementation's last answers to an existing sheet
